title: Ice Senbon
body:
Syntax: perform ice senbon <target>

Description: Haku's needles of ice strike one enemy and may drain Stamina through off balance.  Requires Ice Release and its revealed chakra natures, without a clan bloodline. Base damage: 40-48. 25% chance to inflict off balance. Unlocks at level 25. Costs 24 Chakra and 0 Stamina; 5 second cooldown.

Date: 2026-09-27
